Approx. H42 x W190 x D190 mm

conflicts.reason: The instruction manual's specification table (excluding projecting parts, w × h × d) describes the part; the store page's H42 x W190 x D190 mm with 'Approx. 30g' is not credible for the same part (a 190 mm square at 30 g) and reads as a packaging or listing error. Chosen: the manual.
As for the envelope: the manual's 'Mass Approx. 140 g' over the store page's 'Approx. 30g'.

notes: SOURCE HOSTING CAVEAT: the instruction manual is Sony Interactive Entertainment's own PDF (document 5-064-376-11(1), PDF metadata Author 'Sony Interactive Entertainment Inc.', Title 'CFI-ZVS1', created 2024-09-19), fetched from a manual-hosting mirror because no playstation.com URL for it was found. Its content is the maker's; the host is not. Re-cite the playstation.com copy when one is located; until then treat the envelope as primary-by-content.

Axis map from the manual: width=155, height=11, depth=155 (the stand lying flat). The store page (playstation.com UK) is a value-tier source for the losing conflict candidates only. host_console lists the compatible models as the store page names them, as proposed keys (the CFI-2100 group is folded into cfi-2000).
